tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
all terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should be a Manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied 15mm dia Multijet class B Magnetic type water meters conforming to IS:779/1994 OR ISO:4064/2014 with its latest amendments upto at least 26,400 Nos and above (End user)in any one of the last three years to any Govt. organization (2023-24 to 2025-26) (Necessary supply orders, performance certificates and 3rd party inspection certificates issued by Government agency are to be enclosed)

The tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative(Dealer)/ agent of a Manufacturer meeting with the above requirements in full will also be considered provided:i.The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per the conditions of contract.ii.The tenderer as authorized representative(Dealer) should have supplied satisfactorily at least 9,900Nos. of 15mm dia Multijet Class B Magnetic type water Meters conforming to IS779/1994 OR ISO:4064/2014 with its latest amendments to any Government Organization in one of the last three financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26) (Necessary supply orders, performance certificates and 3rd party inspection certificates issued by Government agency are to be enclosed)

If the Tenderer be a Micro & Small Enterprises who should enclose relevant Certificate issued by Competent Authority, in the absence of which the tenderers will not be considered for further evaluation. If the Tenderer be a MSME Enterprises who must have manufactured, tested and supplied 15mm dia Multijet class B Magnetic type water meters conforming to IS:779/1994 OR ISO:4064/2014 with its latest amendments upto at least 13,200 Nos. to any Govt. organization (End Users) in any one of the last two financial years (2024-25 to 2025-26)
The Tenderer (Manufacturer/Dealer) should possess in Three financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.934.56 Lakh during the last three preceding financial years (2023-24 to 2025-26)
